decisions.reason: Reducing the displayed size of author attribution does not change the requirement to remediate article image quality when necessary.
The author-specific size adjustment does not alter the magazine-wide polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The author-attribution display size does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The author-specific layout adjustment neither resumes nor changes the deferred print-ready output requirement or its technical specifications.
Changing the displayed size of author attribution does not alter where articles must be sourced.
The source changes only the independently modeled author-attribution presentation; it does not change the template obligation, layout inputs, compilation action, or Flat Plan arrangement basis.
